llmResponse.agenda_changes: President Díaz-Slocum announced two groups of changes: (1) Move all second reading and approvals EXCEPT bylaw 9100 (items 13.6-13.10) to consent agenda; (2) Move Measure U addendums (items 13.4-13.5) to consent agenda. This consolidated items 13.4 through 13.10 into the consent bundle. Item 9 (Citizens' Measure U Oversight Committee Year Five Report) was tabled and moved to December 14th meeting.
llmResponse.consent_vote_words: Moving to the Consent items, which includes action items 13.4 to 13.10. Can I have a motion to move them? Second, all in favor? Hi.

Let's see. 16.1 possible other business suggested items for future agendas.
